info.title: facebook_pages (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Facebook Graph API for Pages. Requires a Page Access Token with pages_manage_posts and pages_read_engagement permissions. Requests go to graph.facebook.com/v25.0/{page-id}/...

get.summary: Fetch posts from a Facebook Page's feed. Returns published posts ordered from newest to oldest.
get.description: Fetch posts from a Facebook Page's feed. Returns published posts ordered from newest to oldest.

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: Identifier of the target Facebook Page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many posts to retrieve (default 10, maximum 100).

200.description: {data: [{id, message, story, created_time, permalink_url}], paging: {cursors: {before, after}}}

post.summary: Publish a new post to a Facebook Page's feed. At least one of message or link must be provided.
post.description: Publish a new post to a Facebook Page's feed. At least one of message or link must be provided.

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: Identifier of the target Facebook Page.

requestBody.description: Body: {message (string â€” post body text; either message or link is required), link (string â€” URL to attach as a link preview; either message or link is required), published (optional, boolean â€” default true; set false to create an unpublished/scheduled post), scheduled_publish_time (optional, integer â€” UNIX timestamp for when to publish; must be 10 minutes to 75 days from now; requires published=false), place (optional, string â€” Page ID of a location to associate with the post), tags (optional, string â€” comma-separated list of user IDs of people tagged in this post; requires place), call_to_action (optional, object â€” {type: string, value: {link: string}}), feed_targeting (optional, object â€” controls News Feed targeting), targeting (optional, object â€” limits audience for this content)}

post.summary: Add a photo to a Facebook Page. Provide url for a hosted image or source for a direct file upload. Supports both publish
post.description: Add a photo to a Facebook Page. Provide url for a hosted image or source for a direct file upload. Supports both published and unpublished photo posts.

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: Identifier of the target Facebook Page.

requestBody.description: Body: {url (string â€” publicly accessible photo URL; provide either url or source), source (binary â€” photo file via multipart/form-data; provide either url or source), caption (optional, string â€” description/caption text for the photo), published (optional, boolean â€” default true; set false to upload without publishing), scheduled_publish_time (optional, integer â€” UNIX timestamp to schedule the post; requires published=false), no_story (optional, boolean â€” if true, suppresses the News Feed story generated by the upload), place (optional, string â€” Page ID of a location to tag the photo with), alt_text_custom (optional, string â€” accessible alternative description for the image), temporary (optional, boolean â€” if true, stores photo temporarily ~24h for use in scheduled posts; requires published=false)}

Post.description: A post published on a Facebook Page.

message.description: The body text of the post.

story.description: Auto-generated narrative text attached to this post by the platform.

permalink_url.description: Stable URL linking directly to this post.

is_published.description: Indicates whether the post is live (false means it is scheduled or unpublished).

Photo.description: An image uploaded to a Facebook Page.

post_id.description: Identifier of the post linked to this photo.
